preparation: |Psi(0)> = c_j^dag |Omega_N> / sqrt(1 - <n_j>), Omega_N by the Step 2 rule (STATES)
evolution: exp(-i (H_{N+1} - E_0^N) t); E_0^N kept so G(t) is compared with Step 3 as a complex amplitude
krylov: short-iterative Lanczos, full reorthogonalisation, error estimate <= tol * dt, tol = 1e-10 per unit time, halved to 5e-11; dimension cap 40
finite_size_window: first t where P_return or Q_l (l = 2, 4) departs from the next larger L by more than 0.01 + 2 x static offset; 0.001 also recorded
late_window: second half of the certified interval, from t >= 2
filtered: projection onto Step 3's window: F_WINDOW, or the widest f in F_SCAN holding one line
spectral_reference: Step 3 site_spectra (L <= 12), Lanczos measure with 400 vectors (L = 16)
